intro: This quest marks the final chapter in the search to uncover what befell Teronis and halt the furbolg threat looming over Ashenvale. Bearing Ran Bloodtooth's skull from Krolg, an adventurer returns to Sentinel Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar to report the culmination of their perilous journey.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Return to your own tribe and let them know of your victory here.
Show them your trophy, and bask in the glory...

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Sentinels do what they can here in Ashenvale, but it's thanks to travelers like you that we have gained the ground we have.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, this is the skull of the fiercest furbolg threat in Ashenvale?
I am more than pleased with your abilities, friend. The Sentinels cannot thank you enough. I hope we can rely on you again in the future to help our people.
I shall put this skull and Dartol's Rod in a place of reverence for others to see.
Teronis would be proud. Thank you again.
